update_semantics: Replay one dated daily observation release at a time; refit only rows strictly before each as-of time; no automatic background ingest is claimed.

fit.demand_method: weekday-shrunk log-linear fit + adjacent residual AR(1) conditional moments converted to OU parameters

limitations: These observations are a generated synthetic extension, not real MR DIY operational records.

Fatigue, service and reward weights stay authored; they are not fitted from these records.
Thermal model is a one-zone lumped RC assumption, not a validated building model.
